steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Let me see... That's right, this is the place.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Isn't this place too ornate to be a music store?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Of course – this is the best music store in all of Vyseheim. Otherwise, I wouldn't have brought you here.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: But, I didn't apply to enter the Cliffy Patio.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Those bureaucrats are so inefficient that by the time they process your application, the concert would already be over.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Plus, even if we do get found out, we'd only be looking at a fine.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I heard that if someone helps an Infected leave the Afterglow, the punishment for them is worse than for the Infected.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: What's there to be afraid of? It'll be fine.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Stand up straight and don't act skittish. Just don't let anyone be able to tell and we won't have any issues––

steps.name: Inexperienced Clerk
steps.text: Welcome, Mein Herr. Are you here to pick out an instrument, or...?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Of course. Let's find ourselves a cello first.

steps.name: Inexperienced Clerk
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Inexperienced Clerk
steps.text: Who might this gentleman with you be?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Him? He's my...

steps.name: Inexperienced Clerk
steps.text: Mein Herr, I apologize for my rudeness, but I must remind you that those wearing unauthorized apparel are not allowed into the store.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I'll go wait outside then.

steps.name: Inexperienced Clerk
steps.text: Outside? What exactly are you afraid of, acting all suspicious? Don't tell me you––

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Do you have any idea upon whom you're casting aspersions? Unauthorized? Suspicious? How dare you use such words to describe a noble! Do you value your job or not?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: He's simply fallen on hard times, and has no choice but to dress plainly. His clothes are neither damaged nor dirty, so why would he not be allowed inside the store?

steps.name: Inexperienced Clerk
steps.text: Excuse my rudeness, but this gentleman's attire does not match the store's required style of...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Style?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: My–– cousin, has just suffered a great upheaval. His cello, which he cherished greatly, was destroyed in the turmoil.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I wanted to bring him here to buy a new cello as a way of expressing my condolences. What right do you have to spout nonsense about 'style?'

steps.name: Inexperienced Clerk
steps.text: I am terribly sorry about this, but it is store policy that all customers must be dressed appropriately.

steps.name: Inexperienced Clerk
steps.text: I'm sorry, but I cannot allow your companion to enter.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Fine then!
Ebenholz takes off his cloak and drapes it over Kreide.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Now that he's wearing the same clothes as me, can he enter? Or, is my cloak somehow part of your inappropriate dress?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: If I put my cloak back on later, am I also not allowed to enter?

steps.name: Inexperienced Clerk
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Inexperienced Clerk
steps.text: I... I'll go ask the manager.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: This one can't just mind his own business!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Here, your coat...

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You're welcome.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: It was my idea to bring you here to buy a cello in the first place.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'm bringing you inside the store one way or another, even if I have to pick a fight with that clerk.

steps.name: Inexperienced Clerk
steps.text: We would like to extend our sincerest apologies to both of you.

steps.name: Inexperienced Clerk
steps.text: The manager will be here shortly, and he will personally show you our instruments.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Excuse me, are you busy right now?

steps.name: Friendly Infected
steps.text: Oh, it's Hibiscus!

steps.name: Friendly Infected
steps.text: I've got plenty of time.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: It's about your condition...

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I was worried that clerk was going to report us to the authorities...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Nonsense, it's not like he knew you were an Infected. He just saw your shoddy clothes and took you for a commoner–

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Tsk tsk... Looks like we forgot something.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: We did?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Our suits, of course.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Surely you don't plan to wear this onstage. It's too unprofessional.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Let's go. I'll find you the best tailor in all of Vyseheim––

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: No, I can't. During the fitting, the Originium crystals would...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You do have a point.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: In that case––We'll find the best tailor in the Afterglow. How about it?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: The Sky is blue and fine...♪

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Alright, alright.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I can't thank you enough. For buying this cello for me, and for helping me order a suit!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: The cello's on me. And we haven't even gotten your clothes yet, nor do we know how they'll look on you. You can save your thanks for later.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: We'll know by tomorrow afternoon! I'm sure they'll fit just great!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: So, thank you!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Since we left the store, all you've been doing other than humming is thanking me. We've been over it a dozen times.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Hum, hum.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: The River murmurs clear...♪

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: This tune...

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I think I've heard it before... Or maybe I haven't. Never mind, it's probably just my imagination.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: By the way, you've studied the cello, so why don't you have one of your own? Did it break?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: The teacher who taught me how to play did give me a cello, but it didn't take long for someone to mess it up. Even though it's still sitting back at home, by the time I leave this city... I might only be able to bring the bow with me.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Just the bow? What's the purpose of that?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Seeing the bow is enough to remind me of my teacher.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I'm afraid that if I were to lose the bow, I might forget my teacher as well.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Forget? Don't you remember your teacher just fine?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Actually, I'm already starting to forget...

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: My teacher was a nice Sankta lady with very long hair. She dressed plainly, and always had a smile on her face...

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I used to remember a lot more, as if she were standing right before my eyes... But not anymore.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: There are actually a lot of others I've wanted to remember...

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: So, I need a few keepsakes, to make sure that I won't completely forget.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Keepsakes, huh...?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: What about right now? What do you plan to remember Czerny by?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I suppose a signature would do just fine.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: What about Hibiscus from Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: For Hibiscus, maybe an empty medicine bottle with the Rhodes Island logo?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Pfft. You're too easy to please.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: So long as it helps me remember, the actual object doesn't matter.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: What about me then? It'd be this cello, wouldn't it?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Maybe something else.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: The cello from my teacher didn't last very long. If this one also...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Fair enough.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I want to keep a coin that you gave me. Maybe punch a hole through it and wear it as a pendant. That sounds like a pretty good idea.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Money is how you'll remember me?!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Eh? Is there something wrong with that? Then, I'll pick something else...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: No, no, it's a fine idea.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Shall we head back home and practice?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Actually, I was thinking... Why don't we pay a visit to Herr Czerny's first?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'll pass. It's no secret that he gets all pissy when he sees me.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I'm sure that's just a misunderstanding. It'll get cleared up.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You've been saying that since the first day we met him.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Even if it really is some sort of misunderstanding, I think we're well beyond the point of clearing anything up. So yes, I'll pass after all.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: But Herr Czerny approved of you yesterday, didn't he?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: All misunderstandings have to be resolved bit by bit.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Let's go. I want to see him so we can try out the cello you just got for me.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: It'd be a shame if such a wonderful instrument didn't have a knowledgeable audience.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Excuse me, are you busy right now?

steps.name: Skittish Infected
steps.text: Hibiscus? Sorry, but now's not a very good time.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'd just like you to answer a few questions.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: You're also free to not answer if there's anything you're not comfortable disclosing.

steps.name: Skittish Infected
steps.text: You're not gonna take my blood?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I wouldn't do that without your consent.

steps.name: Skittish Infected
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I don't want to believe it, but this cello isn't something you can find in the Afterglow after one morning of shopping around.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: You went to the Cliffy Patio, didn't you?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I did.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Bold of you.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Actually... Ebenholz got into an argument with a store clerk just so I could go into the store.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: An argument? Did he think your clothes weren't fancy enough for the Cliffy Patio?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: The clerk said something about 'not being able to enter the store unless dressed appropriately,' but do you see anything wrong with Kreide's attire? They were purposely fault-finding because Kreide was wearing commoner's clothes!

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: So you, a noble, have begun to fight for the commoners.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I did it for Kreide!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Regardless of whether he's a noble or a commoner, his skill is more than worthy of the instruments inside that store.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: To deny Kreide entry but to sell those magnificent wares to nobles who needlessly fill their shelves with them would be to treat the finest lumber as firewood.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I didn't expect to hear those words out of your mouth.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Kreide, go ahead and get acquainted with your new instrument.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I'll accompany Ebenholz and have him practice solo for a bit. Let's see if we can change some of his old habits.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Change my habits...? I dare say––

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Yes, Herr Czerny!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: (Whispers) See, all misunderstandings have to be resolved bit by bit.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: (Whispers) Herr Czerny's attitude is already changing. The rest is up to you.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Hello—

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: You that devil?

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: Git outta here. Do you have memory problems or somethin'?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Sorry to bother you.

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: ––Git yer ass back here.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Did you need something?

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: You plannin' to go hide back in your office again, aren't you?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Coffee Shop Owner
steps.text: You're being a bit unreasonable.

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: Who the hell d'you think you are––

steps.name: Coffee Shop Owner
steps.text: You still owe me quite a lot of coffee money, so who do you think I am?

steps.name: Rude Infected
steps.text: Oh, it's you, Herr Biegler... Sorry, didn't notice you there.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Don't mention it.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: At the end of the day, the Afterglow is an Infected settlement. It's real lively here, but you'll run into plenty who can't be reasoned with. Best be careful out there.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Thank you for the reminder.

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Here's my business card, with the phone number of my coffee shop on the front side. If you're ever thirsty, give me a call. We deliver too, real fast.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Haha...

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: By the way, hasn't Andante always been the one in charge of the Rhodes Island office? Did you just get dispatched over here?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Actually, I'm here to investigate some strange happenings.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Oh, Mr. Biegler, regarding your condition––

steps.name: Biegler
steps.text: Strange happenings? What kind of strange are you talking about? I haven't heard a thing.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: So this is what happened...

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: How fares the situation?

steps.name: Frivolous Noble
steps.text: Lachmann's plans proceeded spectacularly.

steps.name: Frivolous Noble
steps.text: Graf Urtica's actions were largely within expectations. Though he did cause some hindrance to Lachmann, it was most likely accidental and did not incur any lasting consequences.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: That's nothing. I never expected Lachmann alone to drive Rhodes Island out of the Afterglow.

steps.name: Frivolous Noble
steps.text: As for Czerny, he already had to expend most of the goodwill he's earned, not to mention copyrights, just to invite those haughty critics to the concert.

steps.name: Frivolous Noble
steps.text: Word also has it that he held his nose and wrote a glowing recommendation for a noble's album that he held nothing but disdain for.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: For someone like him, there's no going back now that he's stooped to this level.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: What about the Sankta from a few days ago? If I remember right, when she applied for entry into the city, she said she came from Laterano to immerse herself in Leithanian culture?

steps.name: Frivolous Noble
steps.text: According to the records, she concluded her tour around Vyseheim and left earlier today for her next destination.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: So we don't have to worry about her.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Let's go. We should be on our way to Afterglow Hall.

steps.name: Frivolous Noble
steps.text: But our appointment with Czerny isn't until tonight.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: There's no shortage of prep work to be done.

steps.name: Gertrude
steps.text: Plus, if that one ever decides to head to Afterglow Hall on a whim, our hired muscle won't be enough to stop him. That's when things get troublesome.
